scenes.title: Spilled Berries
scenes.body: In a sunny meadow, a little fox saw a rabbit with a tipped-over basket. Red berries rolled everywhere in the grass. The fox hurried over and helped pick up every single one.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: A Sweet Share
scenes.body: The rabbit smiled and offered the fox a handful of berries. They sat together under a big oak tree and munched happily. Sharing made the berries taste even sweeter.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: The Windy Hat
scenes.body: A playful gust of wind blew the rabbit's little blue hat up into a tree. The fox climbed the branches carefully and gently brought it down. The rabbit clapped with joy.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about kindness.

scenes.title: Best Friends Forever
scenes.body: As the sun set, the fox and the rabbit sat on a hill, sharing berries and watching the sky turn pink and gold. They promised to always be kind to each other. And from that day on, they were the very best of friends.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about kindness.
